description: Barcode codes for GET /foods/barcode/{code} (#944, ADR 009). Valid = digits only, length 8, 12 or 13, GS1 mod-10 check digit: from the digit before the check digit going left, weights 3,1,3,1,..., check = (10 - sum mod 10) mod 10. 8 digits is always read as EAN-8; a UPC-E code from a pack is expanded to 12-digit UPC-A by the client first (upc_e_expansion). The backend must answer 400 invalid_barcode for every invalid code, with no upstream call; the app's manual digit field must reject the same codes. verify.mjs recomputes every check digit and every expansion. GTIN-14 is not accepted. upc_e_expansion is client-side reference data only: the server never sees a UPC-E and accepts only the expanded 12-digit UPC-A.

invalid.reason: 12 digits that are the EAN-13 minus its last digit: wrong check digit
GTIN-14 (valid check digit) is out of scope
